events.name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Adam Fantilli scored his second goal of the game at 4:21 of overtime and also had an assist to help the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-2 on Thursday night after blowing a two-goal lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fantilli scores second goal of game in OT to lift the Blue Jackets past the Maple Leafs, 3-2

headlines.description: — Alex Ovechkin padded his NHL goals record and moved up a couple other big lists in the Washington Capitals' 8-4...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ovechkin has 33rd hat trick and an assist in Montreal romp to move to No. 10 on points list

events.name: New York Islanders at Detroit Red Wings

headlines.description: — Max Shabanov had two goals and an assist, and Ilya Sorokin stopped 29 shots for his second shutout of the season as the New York Islanders beat the Detroit Red Wings 5-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Shabanov has 2 goals and an assist, Sorokin stops 29 shots as Islanders beat Red Wings 5-0

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Florida Panthers

headlines.description: — Sergei Bobrovsky stopped 31 shots, Sam Reinhart scored in the opening period and the Florida Panthers beat the New Jersey Devils 1-0 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sergei Bobrovsky gets the shutout, Panthers honor Jeff Petry and then top Devils 1-0

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Philadelphia Flyers

headlines.description: — Travis Sanheim scored the winner with 1:09 left in overtime to rally the Philadelphia Flyers past the St. Louis Blues 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanheim scores in OT to rally Flyers past Blues 3-2

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Jake Guentzel scored 1:43 into overtime to give the Tampa Bay Lightning a 2-1 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guentzel scores in OT to give Lightning 2-1 win over Oilers

headlines.description: — Jaden Schwartz scored the tiebreaking goal late in the third period as the Seattle Kraken scored three in the third period to rally past the Chicago Blackhawks 3-2 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwartz caps Kraken's three-goal third period in 3-2 win over Blackhawks

events.name: New York Rangers at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nathan MacKinnon had two goals and an assist to move into second place on the franchise scoring list, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the New York Rangers 6-3 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: MacKinnon, Makar lead surging Avalanche to 6-3 win over Rangers

events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Jack Eichel scored two goals and assisted on a third to power the Vegas Golden Knights to a 4-1 victory over the Utah Mammoth on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eichel scores twice as Golden Knights beat Mammoth 4-1

headlines.description: — Colin Blackwell broke a tie with 9:13 left and the Dallas Stars opened a four-game trip by beating the Vancouver Canucks 4-2 on Thursday night for their sixth victory in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars rebound from loss to beat Canucks 4-2 for 6th win in 7 games

headlines.description: — Drake Batherson scored the tiebreaking goal with 1:58 to play, and the Ottawa Senators held off a furious Anaheim rally after the Ducks pulled their goalie in the final minutes for a 3-2 victory Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Batherson's deflection leads to winning goal in Senators' 3-2 victory over Ducks

events.name: Los Angeles Kings at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Philipp Kurashev scored in regulation and the only goal of a shootout, and the San Jose Sharks held on for a 4-3 win over the Los Angeles Kings on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kurashev scores only goal of shootout, Sharks beat the Kings 4-3
